Setup value emailBody: Email body (the original node left it blank) (for example Hello, ...). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.
Setup value recipientEmail: Recipient email address (for example you@example.com). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.
Setup value whatsappMessage: WhatsApp message text (the original node left it blank) (for example Thanks, we received your message.). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.
Setup value recipientPhone: Recipient phone number (E.164) (for example +15551234567). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.
Setup value whatsappPhoneNumberId: WhatsApp Business phone number id (for example 123456789012345). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.

Workflow secret ERPNEXT_API_KEY: erpnext.syncbricks.com ERPNext API key and secret ("<api key>:<api secret>") for erpnext.syncbricks.com (Authorization: token <secret>). Add it in the workflow editor's Secrets panel after import; never paste it in chat.
Provide run inputs: body, query, headers.

hints: The original started from an inbound webhook (POST /syncbricks-com-tutorial-candidate-shortlist). Run it with `cdecli workflow run <slug> --ver <version> -d '{"body": {...}}'` or through the workflow API.
"Txt File to Text (Example)" (extractFromFile.text): Files flow as text or base64 fields on Yantra, not binary attachments; check the previous step hands over the file content.
"PDF to Text" (extractFromFile.pdf): Parsed via googlesuper/GOOGLESUPER_PARSE_FILE; the file must live on Google Drive (upload first if the previous step only has bytes/base64).

"PDF to Text": GOOGLESUPER_PARSE_FILE needs a Drive file_id (and googlesuper credential). If the upstream step only has file bytes, upload with GOOGLESUPER_CREATE_FILE_FROM_TEXT / Drive upload first, then parse.
"Merge1" merged two branches; NodeSync waits for both inputs and exposes them as data1/data2 (the original merge mode was append).
"Update Applicant Data" authenticated with erpNextApi in the original; add the matching Authorization header (or use the service's connector).
"Reject Applicant" authenticated with erpNextApi in the original; add the matching Authorization header (or use the service's connector).
"Accept Applicant" authenticated with erpNextApi in the original; add the matching Authorization header (or use the service's connector).
Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.
Connect erpnext: `cdecli credential create -n "erpnext" -p erpnext --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).
Connect googlesuper: `cdecli credential create -n "googlesuper" -p googlesuper --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).
Connect whatsapp: `cdecli credential create -n "whatsapp" -p whatsapp --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).
